news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics to Announce Financial Results for the Second Quarter on Thursday, August 13, 2026
news.summary: Nektar announced it will report Q2 2026 financial results after market close on Thursday, August 13, 2026, with CEO Howard Robin hosting a conference call at 5:00pm ET to discuss results.

news.headline: Is Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Undervalued On Its Phase 3 Rezpegaldesleukin Launch?
news.summary: An analysis examined whether Nektar's stock valuation adequately reflects the newly launched Phase 3 program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis and the drug's market potential.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar initiated the first two global registrational Phase 3 trials (ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2), each enrolling ~510 biologic/JAK-naive patients 12+ years old; a third trial (ZENITH AD-3) for treatment-experienced patients is set to begin in September 2026, with topline data expected mid-2028 and a targeted BLA submission in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar's Board granted non-qualified stock options for 36,000 shares to 23 newly hired employees under its 2025 Inducement Plan, with an exercise price of $64.84 (the July 20 closing price) vesting over four years.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares rose about 10.6% as sentiment toward immunology/inflammation biotechs improved, with analysts flagging Nektar as a beneficiary of the read-through from AbbVie's reported pursuit of Apogee Therapeutics.

news.headline: Insider Sell: Jonathan Zalevsky Sells Shares of Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR)
news.summary: Chief Research and Development Officer Jonathan Zalevsky sold 5,681 shares of Nektar common stock on June 30, 2026, per an SEC Form 4 filing.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Nektar reports second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close, with a CEO-hosted conference call at 5:00pm ET.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third Phase 3 trial in the ZENITH AD program (rezpegaldesleukin in biologic/JAK treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) is set to begin enrollment.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Planned initiation of a single registrational Phase 3 trial for rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata, following End-of-Phase 2 FDA meetings and EMA scientific advice.

catalysts.label: Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 (TrialNet) initial data
catalysts.detail: Initial data expected from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in new-onset stage 3 Type 1 diabetes.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Company-guided timeline for initial topline results from the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 registrational trials in atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: Targeted BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar's targeted timeline for a Biologics License Application submission for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis, pending positive Phase 3 results.

pulse: Nektar's story now centers almost entirely on rezpegaldesleukin's Phase 3 ZENITH AD program in atopic dermatitis, which began dosing patients on July 21, 2026, with topline data not expected until mid-2028 — leaving a long, binary wait ahead. Near-term stock moves have been driven more by sector-wide immunology sentiment (e.g., the AbbVie/Apogee read-through) than company-specific news, while routine insider selling continues in the background. Q2 2026 earnings on August 13, 2026 will be the next concrete checkpoint, with investors watching cash runway against the newly ramped Phase 3 spend.
